description: The consensus: a market-implied probability per outcome (home, away, draw) for games starting within 24 hours and those being played, at most 1 s old. recent false means no current consensus. Needs an API key.

fixture.description: one fixture id, e.g. nba-261030-mia-cha (from list_fixtures); default all of the league

league.description: one league (mlb, nba, nfl, cfb, nhl, epl, bund, laliga, ucl); default all

name: get_consensus
